newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE May coffee futures hit new 9-mth high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE May coffee futures hit new 9-mth high.

text.p: LIFFE May robusta coffee futures hit new nine-month high of $1,800 a tonne, up a hefty $102 or six percent on the day.
The second-month contract last breached the $1,800-barrier in late June last year on Brazilian frost scare.
At 1616 GMT, May rose further to a high of $1,805, up $107.

The latest rally was powered by sky-rocketing New York arabica futures on persistent supply worries, stemmed by forecasts of lower 1997/98 Brazilian crop and recent news of disruptions to Central American exports.
